purpose: independent semantic correctness audit; no performance claim
independence: Decoded retained raw-rows.json compared per vertex against original reference text and separate stdlib BFS/Dijkstra/component/fixed-step uniform+dangling PR recurrences; benchmark helper compare() was not imported or called.
schema_boundary: Retained declared Spark result schema plus independent checks of decoded row field names and Python value types; no separate Parquet result is produced by this tiny collected-output suite.
tolerance: Finite PR/SSSP abs(actual-reference) <= 0.0001*abs(reference); reference zero requires exact zero. BFS depths and canonical WCC labels exact. Distance null alone is adapted to official unreachable sentinel/infinity; raw nulls retained and unreachable hops/parent additionally checked.
tested_id_domain: Fixture positive signed BIGINT identifiers; not the full unsigned 64-bit Graphalytics ID domain

post_snapshot_exceptions.reason: This independent audit is written after the successful 202-file archive comparison; it did not exist when run_host_v2 copied the archive.
